property_eligibility: Omit missing, nonnumeric, nonfinite or physically invalid values. BET must be nonnegative; Celsius TGA temperature must be at least -273.15. No upper cutoff, percentile clipping or imputation.
doi_counting: Count a DOI once per nonempty category; independently rank DOI categories. Different categories can share a DOI. Numeric panels use the median eligible value per DOI.
stability_normalization: Trim/collapse whitespace and lowercase. Yes/no become Yes/No; blank and explicit not_reported become Not reported. Unexpected values raise an error.
stability_doi_counting: A DOI counts once in every category represented by its synthesis records. Categories may overlap, including Not reported alongside Yes/No. Percentages use all 4568 DOIs and need not sum to 100%.
stability_layout: Air and water labels; records in panel a and DOI counts in panel b.
